notes: Ollama Cloud now speaks Ollama's own API first: the provider endpoint is the native https://ollama.com/api root from Ollama's cloud documentation. The connection test tries the native /api/chat endpoint first (then /v1 as a fallback), the Claude Code runtime gateway does the same on every prompt, and model discovery reads the native /api/tags catalog first - so a key that works anywhere on ollama.com now validates and runs. Key checks now say which service rejected them: if a key is tested against the wrong provider card (an Ollama Cloud key pasted under DeepSeek, for example) the error names the endpoint that answered instead of a generic 'invalid key', so it is obvious the provider selection, not the key, needs to change. Saved Ollama Cloud setups migrate automatically to the new endpoint. Same signing key - installs directly over v1.0.15 with one tap.
